scope: Diagnosis only. No suppression has been verified to work; no Gazebo fix attempted.

producer.explanation: the gz sim server: gz is a ruby script that rewrites $0, so ps shows "gz sim -s -r" while the executable image is ruby

gazebo_backtrace: #0 Object "[0x7eaab8432b10]" - address not mapped to object
crash_site.reading: a library was unloaded while one of its threads was still running; the core map is a post-unmap snapshot so the library cannot be named from it

triggers.case: manual pkill SIGTERM to the server
process-group SIGINT, the path tools/validate_rendered_linescan.py:392 uses
linescan:=false linescan_backend:=render, project plugin not loaded

failed_suppressions.evidence: minimal always-segfaulting program under soft RLIMIT_CORE=0 still produced a dump; a pipe core_pattern does not honour the zero limit
four consecutive segfaults after the restart accumulated four dumps; no deletion and no cap observed
failed_suppressions.not_tested: whether a positive maxCrashDumpCount enforces its limit

untested_suppression.rationale: without a pipe the default zero soft limit suppresses the dump entirely
untested_suppression.status: not needed if maxCrashDumpCount=-1 works; kept as a fallback

not_covered: how much C: space was consumed historically

setting_semantics.collection_guard: WslCoreVm.cpp starts the collection thread and appends WSL_ENABLE_CRASH_DUMP=1 to the kernel command line only when MaxCrashDumpCount >= 0
setting_semantics.linux_side: linux/init/main.cpp calls EnableCrashDumpCollection(), which installs the pipe core_pattern, only when that variable is present
setting_semantics.enforcement: wslutil.cpp EnforceFileLimit begins with "if (Limit <= 0) return;" and deletes one oldest file per call

meaning.positive: collection on, folder held at about N files
meaning.zero: collection on, cleanup skipped entirely - unbounded growth, the worst value
meaning.negative: collection never enabled; no pipe core_pattern, no dumps
